summary.text: Josh Wallenstein is a Democrat and compliance and ethics attorney running for Texas House of Representatives District 133 in the November 3, 2026 general election against incumbent Republican Mano Deayala.

paragraphs.text: Josh Wallenstein was born in Austin, Texas, and earned a bachelor's degree from Southern Methodist University in 1997 and a law degree from Stanford Law School in 2002.
His career experience includes working as a compliance and ethics attorney.
As of 2024, Ballotpedia listed him as a member of the New York, District of Columbia and Texas bars, parliamentarian of West Houston Democrats, and a board director of the TRACE Foundation.

Wallenstein ran in the Democratic primary for Harris County Department of Education Board of Trustees Position 3, At-Large, losing to incumbent Richard Cantu in the 2018 primary runoff and again in the March 5, 2024 primary.
He won the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary for Texas House District 133 with no opposition.

In a Ballotpedia survey, his campaign described him as a native Texan raised by a single mother after his father died when he was seven, and listed lowering costs, funding public schools and expanding Medicaid among his priorities.
